name: RogueIQ
tagline: Smarter about money. For you and your AI.

subline: Free tools for your money you can try in seconds, built on public data you can check. Your agent can plug into every one.
description: RogueIQ makes market tools and sourced money news that show where the market stands today, for you and your AI agent. Every item links its official source and date.
disclaimer: RogueIQ provides general education and tools, not personalized investment, tax or legal advice. Data may be delayed or contain errors; check the source before making decisions. Nothing on this site is an offer or solicitation to buy or sell any security.

charts.title: Tech investment as a share of GDP is above the dot-com peak
charts.alt: Line chart of business spending on information processing equipment and software as a share of US GDP since 1947, reaching a record in Q2 2026 above the Q4 2000 dot-com peak.

sources.label: BEA via FRED: Private fixed investment in information processing equipment and software (A679RC1Q027SBEA)

charts.takeaway: As of Q2 2026, private fixed investment in information processing equipment and software was 5.05% of GDP, above the dot-com peak of 4.46% (Q4 2000). Source: BEA via FRED, A679RC1Q027SBEA.
charts.as_of: Data as of Q2 2026 (FRED series updated Sep 30, 2026)

charts.title: How a 3x fund loses on a round trip
charts.alt: Chart showing how a daily-reset 3x leveraged fund can end below its starting value after the underlying index goes down and back up.

sources.label: RogueIQ calculation (arithmetic of a daily-reset 3x fund)
Daily reset: Direxion SOXL fund page

charts.takeaway: If the index drops 10% and recovers, a 3x fund is still down about 7%.
charts.note: Hypothetical illustration, not a prediction. Assumes daily reset, before fees; real results depend on the path of returns.
